name: Reason Machines
long_description:
Reason is an AI teammate for work and code that runs autonomous cloud agents with a frontier harness on cost per task.

It delivers the same performance with 22% lower costs than Codex. By operating with a harness outside the sandbox, it acts seamlessly across cloud computers and local devices.

Reason runs work from start to finish: from an issue to a finished pull request, on a schedule, or from a Slack alert. It is available as a Mac app, on the web, from the CLI, in Slack, and through a REST API, with about 100 integrations and shareable skills. Bring your own keys and subscriptions, and work rolls over to the next one when limits are hit.
one_liner: Reason is the AI teammate for work and code.
